summary: {person} asks the budget office to show the assumptions behind money restored for transit.
realLife: Milwaukee’s board chair used revised sales-tax estimates and changes to debt payments to make room for transit funding.
gates: A service amendment relies on a revised revenue estimate.
weights: A weaker recent revenue report increases scrutiny of the estimate.
inGame: needs: prior and amended revenue estimates, debt payment schedules and transit allocation.

turns.what: The chair defends the revised estimate at the hearing.
turns.pulledBy: The finance officer confirms the receipts are on pace.

turns.what: Finance recalculates the amount available for service.
turns.pulledBy: Receipts fall short of the estimate.
turns.writesBack: Record the new gap against the original forecast.
